rules.title: Real fans, real names optional, real respect
rules.description: No personal attacks on players, coaches, staff or other posters. Argue the take, not the person.

rules.title: No rumors as fact
rules.description: Injury, recruiting, transfer or legal claims need a link to a published report. Say 'I heard' if that is all you have.

rules.title: No doxxing, no harassment
rules.description: Never post anyone's contact information, location, workplace or family. First offense is removal.

rules.title: Keep paid content paid
rules.description: Do not paste Magazine or members-only text into public threads. Link to it instead.

rules.title: No spam, no promo
rules.description: No product plugs, ticket resale, betting touts or link farms. AI spam protection is on, and staff delete without notice.

rules.title: One game, one thread
rules.description: Game talk goes in the pinned game thread. It opens Tuesday and closes after the recap.

rules.title: Staff decisions are final
rules.description: Moderators may remove posts and members. Appeals go to the Contact page, not the thread.

note: Replaces all rules on that group. Owner: Jarvis. Not sent by this script.
